name: button-group
description: A source-owned shadcn-style ButtonGroup for Dioxus.

documentation.compositionNote: Visually joins related buttons/form controls (ButtonGroup/ButtonGroupText/ButtonGroupSeparator) via adjoining borders/radii, matching upstream's cva-driven orientation variant with a plain Rust enum instead. ButtonGroupSeparator composes the owned adico_primitives::separator::Separator primitive, matching how ToolbarSeparator composes its own primitive counterpart.
